channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: How Trump Gave the Worst Polluters a Free Pass
item.description: The president temporarily waived clean-air rules for industrial facilities that spew cancer-causing gases. Then his appointees worked to gut the regulations altogether.

item.title: NPR: Perspective: The next James Bond
item.description: A new James Bond is nigh, to replace the last actor in the 64 year-old movie franchise. What evil forces will the new 007 face? Killer Drones? Killer AI? Killer lettuce?

item.title: BBC News: Met Police says letter with claims about Meghan's father not shared with other law enforcement
item.description: The Met said it passed information to the duchess but did not share it with other law enforcement agencies.

item.title: The Guardian: As a divided Israel prepares to go to the polls, can Netanyahu pull off his greatest political trick yet?
item.description: The prime minister has defined and dominated his country’s politics for three decades and is putting his rivals on the defensive before Tuesday’s general election They chant his name, they cheer and clap – and yet he is…

item.title: Al Jazeera: FIFA’s Infantino touts global re-election support amid resignation questions
item.description: Support from Asian federation bolsters FIFA's Gianni Infantino as he seeks re-election as president for a fourth term.

item.title: Ars Technica: A 1,000-mile cloud on Mars may reveal physics never seen in nature
item.description: A new model suggests Mars may host ice-forming physics never directly observed before.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: She Was the DEA’s Premier Crypto Detective. The Clues Led Straight to Her Own Family
item.description: To escape the chaos of her Russian childhood, Lili Infante became an American law enforcement prodigy. She pioneered the DEA’s investigations of the dark web—never suspecting who she’d find hiding there.

item.title: WIRED Science: New mRNA Vaccine Reduces Risk of Melanoma Recurrence by Over 40 Percent
item.description: The vaccine is personalized to a patient’s tumor, and results from the Phase 3 trial are yet another example of the promise of mRNA vaccines in treating cancer.

item.title: WIRED Business: How Many Billions Would It Take to Hold Meta Accountable?
item.description: Meta got hit this week with its biggest fine yet, the latest in a mounting pile of court-ordered payments.

item.title: The New Yorker: The Great Schlep
item.description: Tens of thousands of Israelis living abroad are flying back to cast votes in what many describe as the most pivotal election in the country’s history.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: What Dua Lipa, JT, and Alexa Demie Wore This Week
item.description: In a month packed with movie premieres, galas, and random anniversaries, our favorite celebrities had countless avenues to show off a ‘fit.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: Everyone Knew About the A-Team
item.description: How did the Alexander brothers become real-estate elites while allegedly raping or assaulting more than a dozen women?

item.description: INDIANAPOLIS - An investigation is underway after a person was critically injured in a shooting on Indy's northeast side Saturday morning. According to the Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department, just before 4 a.m.,…
